about: Algorithm profiles for c-expect and b-tls (PROFILE=<name>). Each profile lists the residue.sh EXPECT rules that count for EXPECT=kem and EXPECT=sig, the hybrid TLS group b-tls offers alone, and the certificate keys EXPECT=cert accepts. This file is in the ruleset hash, and receipt.json records the profile name in params.profile. nist-cat3 is the default: NIST security category 3 or above (ML-KEM-768 or ML-KEM-1024; ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87 or an SLH-DSA 192 or 256 parameter set from FIPS 205, ruleset 4). cnsa2 asks for category 5 only (ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-87, SecP384r1MLKEM1024), as CNSA 2.0 does; it does not count SLH-DSA. kpqc also counts the Korean KpqC algorithms (SMAUG-T, NTRU+, HAETAE, AIMer), which NIST has not approved. impl_accept (kpqc only) lists the KpqC reference KAT versions that pqproof impl judge accepts: latest, <parameter>@<version> or <algorithm>@<version>; a match with any other version needs review. A profile never makes a classical line pass.

kpqc.title: NIST category 3 or above, or the Korean KpqC algorithms
